payload.body: You tend to move between taking up space and pulling away from it. You lead the conversation, share the bold idea, or enjoy being noticed, then become guarded when someone reacts to the stronger version of you. This often comes from learning that attention was safe only when you were pleasing, polished, or easy to understand. Stay present for one response before deciding that being seen was a mistake.
payload.astroHint: Lilith opposite the Sun can make you alternate between wanting recognition and wanting to escape other people's attention.
